steps.name: wake up
steps.objective: Report the quest to [Iris] in the “Oracle Room.”

steps.name: hill where the villain can be seen
steps.objective: Talk to [Iris] in the “Oracle Room” and report the quest to [Theodore] in “Guild Alliance City Esnir.”

lines.text: (The sound of an unknown bird tickles my ears. And when the sound disappears, something small comes to the tip of my nose riding the warm wind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It tickles… .
(Iris approaches %s, who is looking at the small leaf that has fallen on his face, and gently makes eye contact and says hello.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Good morning, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Good morning, Iris.
(Iris grabs the hands of the startled %s.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Don't worry. It's the morning after I fall asleep.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah? thank god… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I feel like I've been surprised for a few days now... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I tried not to be surprised, but it didn't work. I think it's because I experienced many things in Bigrid and Highland.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: How about taking a little break?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … If Iris takes a break, I will do the same.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: You say that even though you know very well that you can't do that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Because I am that kind of person.
(Iris looks at %s's smile and laughs along.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That's why I don't hide anything from %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was a little surprised. Who would have thought that Hecate would come and go while I was sleeping... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, what do you want to do with Iris? You said you could live like an ordinary person.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm not sure if Hecate's words are sincere or not. Even if it's sincere, nothing changes.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I have a job I must do. I must follow Ceres' will and maintain my position as a star god.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: At least for the day when Ceres comes back... . Although it may turn against Hecate.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel Iris’s sincerity….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But why did Hecate want to take me?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I don't know, but I have a bad feeling. That's the condition that allows me to return to being human... .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Unless I give up on myself, that will never happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Don't ask too much about the obvious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, okay. Did you say anything else besides that?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: He left, asking us to look between the great walls. When I checked what he was talking about, I saw the man.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That guy?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: The Baral that attacked us in Rosengarten and Avalon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral? Is Baral alive?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: As I was going somewhere after leaving the gate of the Demon World, I saw a large whirlpool between mountains full of rocks.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is it? Now I can't believe I've gone all the way to the demon world. I don't know what they're planning, but I have to go.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Shall we go right away?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah. Because I don’t know where it is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris, I'll go and gather some information. I have to go there to find out Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But... , all right.
(Iris makes a helpless expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be careful.  and… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd like to say a Highland greeting to Iris too, is that okay?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: May the happy times of Nornir be with Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: May the happy times of Nornir be with %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (So where should we go? A canyon with a big whirlpool... I've never heard of it...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Oh, Professor Theodore might know... I'll have to go first.)

steps.name: Request from the academy director
steps.objective: Talk to [Theodore] in “Guild Alliance City Esnil”, pass through the lobby of “Magic Academy Zerenis” and report the quest to [Chloris] in the “Academy Director’s Office”.

lines.text: (At an outdoor table at a cafe in the center of Esnil, Professor Theodore continues to write people's names in his notebook over a cup of coffee.)

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Hmm, where did I see this name before? That person is, that person... . uh? %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Professor. No, Theo.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It's been a while. How have you been?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've been doing well. I haven't been able to visit you often due to various things going on.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It's okay. You can do that if you're busy. I heard about it from Dayna, Shiina, and the old man, so I know a little bit about it.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Old man, ah... . This is Helena, whom you also know. I can’t remember when I first found out about it.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: When I had many dreams, I participated in an excavation team led by Helena to gain experience, and our relationship continued thereafter.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: He is like a teacher in life. But now that I am acting as a teacher for the princesses, it is truly amazing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Now, %s. So what brought you here? Judging by the fact that he came to see me, it doesn't seem like it was just some business.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have a place I need to go, but I don't know where it is.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Let me explain.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know of a place in the middle of a rocky mountain or hill where whirlpools constantly occur?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Ah… , are you talking about there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you know.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: There is only one place where large whirlpools occur: Bayuna Canyon.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It was a canyon with nothing but rocks and mushrooms, but at some point a whirlpool appeared and wouldn't disappear.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: In addition to people who went to collect rare mushrooms, scholars who were interested in the whirlpool went there, but they didn't find anything.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Although magical energy often forms a vortex between the western and eastern parts of the continent, it was different from that of Bayuna Canyon.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Hmm, I wonder if anyone is still investigating... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Theo. But where do I go to get there?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You went to the Orcarium with Narsha once, right? If you follow the southern coast there, there is a path that takes you to the area near the canyon.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I recently heard that Council soldiers were stationed at the Orcarium. Is it because of the previous accident, or is there something else going on? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Apparently, after going to Bigrid, I couldn’t see Aaron there. Maybe that’s why….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, should I ask Zephyrus?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Zephyrus? Although he was once a student of mine, he is now a member of the Magic Agency... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It'll be okay.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Is that so? If it's okay with you, it's okay. Now that I think about it, it seems like you and the director of Chloris Academy are getting along well these days... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you ever seen these two together?

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: That's not it. Chloris came to visit me for a conference and we had tea together... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: When I asked him how he was doing these days, he seemed incredibly embarrassed. I was glad it looked okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah… .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: By the way, I don't know if you know, but your name has been mentioned often among people in the empire these days.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It has a bad connotation to the council, but to the general public, he is seen as a hero from another continent. Should I say that I am at the center of the rumor... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: If you happen to go to Glaston, please be careful. And I'm sorry, but could you bring this book to Chloris on the way?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. But this book is quite thick.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: It's a book that records the history of the empire. The director of Chloris Academy said he couldn't find this.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: I don't know why I couldn't find what I saw as soon as I entered the Belfar Library.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Theo, thank you. Then, I will go to that magic academy. good bye.

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: You're always busy. Come on, let’s go.
(Theodore sends Adventurer and looks again at the name written in the notebook.)

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: … The name Hilda is definitely... .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: Right… .

lines.speaker: 테오도르
lines.text: The first witch the empire captured and executed as an example... .
(In front of the door of the academy director's office at Magic Academy Zerenis. The moment you try to approach to knock, a barrier created by magical power blocks your path.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uh… ?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: This shouldn't be a big deal to %s, but I'm surprised.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyrus?
(Zephyros adjusts his glasses and opens the magic book. Then, a small wind rises from the center of the magic book and shakes the magic barrier.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There is an important exam for the students soon, and the exam-related documents and various records are in the academy director's office, so a security barrier has been installed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somehow... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There is more to worry about when it comes to the academic schedule than you might think. By the way, I was planning to call you when the time comes... . Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's it... .
(At that time, Chloris' voice is heard from inside the academy's principal's office.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스의 목소리
lines.text: Hey, two people... . Don't do it outside, come in.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, let's go in and talk like Chloe said.

steps.name: a little tea time
steps.objective: Talk to [Chloris] in the “Magic Academy Dean’s Office” and report the quest to [Zephyros] in the “Magic Academy Dean’s Office.”

lines.text: (Chloris is sitting at her desk and stands up when she sees %s coming in with Zephyrus.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Mr. Chloris. You look busy today too.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If you come to your senses, work tends to grow like a snowball.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Please save me... .
(Zephyros, who was watching Chloris complaining, quietly stretches out his hand and pulls Chloris' cheeks.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Wooaaaa, De, Deppy, what are you doing?!
(Chloris seems to be asking Zephyrus what he is doing now.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Come to your senses, academy principal. This isn't why you're holding on to your position as the academy's president, right?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Hey kid. Hey kid.
(Chloris seems to say no.)
(Zephyros laughs lightly at Chloris, who shakes his hand away and gives it a grin. Then, he gently holds out a small box that he had prepared in advance.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It must have been frustrating working in the academy director's office, so try this while eating.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You know the walnut pie that I praised before for being delicious?  It’s been a while since I made this… .
(Cloris looks at the dessert in the box in surprise and smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, sorry. We only talked about ourselves too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. right. Mr. Chloris, here. Professor Theo told me to pass it on.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ah, this. I have to go get it, but I'm sorry I brought it here. I was wondering if I could get it... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: How did Professor Theodore obtain that book? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If the professor got it for you, it's a history book, right?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's a history book, but it's not a typical book.
(Cloris nods quietly and opens the book. She turns the pages and shows the inside.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: To people like you, it appears to be a general history-related book, but to anyone who feels the slightest bit of magic, you will see black pages like this.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You can see it in %s’s eyes too, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Oh, is it really?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It’s a bit of a story… . An organization called the Imperial Record Office records big and small things that happen in the empire.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: General information can be learned at educational institutions such as the Magic Academy, the Tower of the Wise, and the Imperial Academy. In the form of classes or lectures.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So there are some things that are not general?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That's right. Just as there is light and there is darkness, so is history. For example, the evil deeds of nobles belonging to the council, the emperor who ascended the throne after killing his brother, etc... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The first emperor ordered such information to be recorded by a method other than a copyist, in case something unexpected happened.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If you leave that job to an ordinary person, something dangerous will definitely happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Archmage Zerenis, with the help of the librarians at the Belfar Library, created a book that can never be destroyed.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: When a scribe left a message, the spirits of records transferred it into an indestructible book.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: When the evil ones learned of the book's existence, they tried to destroy it, but it wasn't easy.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It would be impossible to disturb the library of Belfa, the god of knowledge itself, and it would have been difficult to find this book there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But how did you find this book, Professor?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … They say books appear on their own for extreme bookworms, and that seems to be true.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Anyway, I think some people with bad intentions have found this book. Even so, it wouldn't have been easy to destroy.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Because it is protected by a power that cannot even be touched by ordinary magic power.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: In the end, those steeped in darkness turned the contents into black pages like this so that others could never see them.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are tons of black pages. What on earth is there... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There may be a lot of things we can't even imagine, but there is one part I want to check.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: A long time ago, in the early days of the Magic Agency, about the head of the Magic Agency who retired in disgrace... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait a minute, Zephyrus. It seems like you'd need a ton of horsepower to easily see the black pages... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's okay because I have Windy Seed. It won't be dangerous.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As long as it doesn't fuse with the Windy Seed like it did back then... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: No!! I won't destroy the school this time!!

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, calm down.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Ugh, yeah.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Sorry, Mr. %s. I guess I've been suffering from work stress lately.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. are you okay.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew, that won't work. I need some time to rest.
(Zephyros sighs briefly, takes out a piece of walnut pie from the box, and puts it in Chloris' mouth.)
(Then give %s a slice of walnut pie on a small plate.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, let’s eat first.

steps.name: Zephyrus' Vacation
steps.objective: Talk to [Zephyros] in the “Magic Academy Dean’s Office” and report the quest to [Notos] in the “Nereis Gate.”

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Haha, I love it. As expected, the pies made by Jeffy are the best.
(Chloris smiles brightly at Zephyrus, as if she is satisfied.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's the only thing I can do, so it would be difficult to make it taste bad. I don't want to ruin my mother's recipe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your mother was a good cook. It's very delicious.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: My mother made this pie not long before she passed away... . Oh, this is not the time to talk about this.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, snap.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: … Eh, a. What did I… .
(Cloris covers her eyes with both hands and pretends nothing is wrong.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, I'm fine, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's the same as usual.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank goodness. lol. By the way, Mr. %s. You didn’t come just to bring me books, right? It looks like you have other business as well... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I was already trying to check the contents of the book, and it just so happened to work out well. Listen and go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it okay to listen... . By the way, can you check the contents of the book here? Can I use magic power in the academy director's office?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's okay, %s. This place is safer than it looks... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: All we have to do is place our hands on the book.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's simpler than you think, right?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Let's say it's thanks to Windy Seed.
(Zephyros looks through the book and opens the page he thinks he wants. He then grabs Chloris' hand and places it on top of it.)
(Then small leaves appear with a warm wind and fall on the hands of the two people.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems more like spirit power than magic.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I guess so.
(When Chloris and Zephyrus remove the leaves from the pages of the book, the parts that were painted black appear white.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … Here's the part I wanted to know. I'll read it for a moment.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “The 3rd Commissioner of Magic, Crowley, was a disciple of the Archmage Zerenis, but before his master passed away, he caused small and large frictions.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “While Zerenis dreamed of a future with other races, Crowley dreamed of a future centered entirely on the empire.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “A few years after Zerenis passed away, with the approval of the Council, part of the territory of the Beast Empire Creed was transferred to the Empire.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “The damage to the empire was small. The conflict was minimized as hundreds of beastmen, including the Beast King, went missing. “Their whereabouts are unknown.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait a minute... Did you say Minos and Pasiphae were trapped and missing?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “During this process, Crowley was recognized for his contributions and was given a key position in the Magic Agency. And as time passes and the second head of the Office of Magic retires, he naturally becomes the third head of the Office of Magic.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “The council is aware of the situation where witches who have been quiet for a while are appearing and harming the residents. Then, one agenda item is proposed and approved.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “Witch hunt.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “The year the witch hunt began, the first witch was executed.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The next part describes how the empire has changed since the Sky of Chaos. .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: “The third Commissioner of Magic, Crowley, retires in disgrace because he touched an ancient forbidden book. However, after retirement, he established a private magic research institute.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … There's no more information about Crowley.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this the private magic research institute I know of?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That's the lab that tried to conduct horror experiments using the mercenary group stationed in Mirgandia.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: At one time, it was prosperous and had 3 research centers, but now only 2 research centers remain. I'm in charge of work that the Magic Agency doesn't do.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: On the surface, it may seem like something helpful to the residents, but... … .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Looking at this record, I think it's clear. The contents of the banned book that Crowley touched and the disappeared Creed beasts... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: … It's so terrible... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Now I have to find other evidence. It's still probably still there somewhere. Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s find it together. We have to find out somehow.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew, that should be it. thanks. %s… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … Ah, but what about other business?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyrus, are you still part of the Magic Agency?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I haven't been kicked out yet. But, it may happen soon. When I asked about being part of the Magic Agency, I thought that was important... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Briefly explain to Zephyrus why you should go to Bayuna Canyon.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how it happened.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Hmm… .
(Zephyros appears to be worried and looks quietly at Chloris.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, no. Principal, I will take a vacation.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Suddenly? Wait, no. If you're going to go, go together. This time... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Director of Chloris Academy, what will you do if the academic schedule is disrupted?
(Zephyros points to the pile of documents piled up in front of Chloris.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Phew… , Chairman, you are doing it too much.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's too much. Normally, this time of year is when the academy director does the most work.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Don't worry too much. As you know, near Bayuna Canyon... .

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I know. What kind of place is it... . If you say that, what should I do?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I'll send it to you. Have a nice trip. And I hope nothing bad happens in my hometown.
(Chloris shows a lonely smile, but smiles brightly again and hugs Zephyros.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hometown?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mr. %s, please come back with Zephyr.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was hoping to get some help from the Ministry of Magic, but I didn't know we would be going together.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: One way is to avoid the eyes of the Magic Agency and go to the Orcarium, but let's go a little safer.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: This is the opinion of neither a magician belonging to the Magic Agency nor the chairman of a magic academy, but a simple returnee looking for his hometown.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just a simple returnee. Haha. So where should we go?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Nereis Gate, there's someone there who can help.

steps.name: Notos Vacation
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Notos] at the “Nereis Gate” and go to the “Gateway”. 
2. Use the gate to go to “Bayuna Canyon” and report the quest to [Notos] in “Bayuna Canyon”.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … Phew, the work is finally over. Let’s take a breather and get some rest.
(Notos stretches out in front of the Nereis Gateway Center and looks blankly at the sky. A wind blowing from somewhere tickles the tip of Notos' nose.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's been a while since the wind blew from the west at this time.
Stinging.
(Several small birds chirp and fly to Notos and land.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Uh, why did the birds that were supposed to be in the canyon fly all the way here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Notos, you happened to be here.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah, %s. Are you here? I already cleaned [the room of the great %s]... .
(Notos looks at the face of the person standing next to %s and is speechless for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: [Room of the Great %s]? Why on earth is that room called that?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It is a noble name given by His Majesty.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Oh, really? It seems special because His Majesty came here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, don't keep talking about that room. It's embarrassing for the listener... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha, I understand.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Anyway, it's been a while. my little brother

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yes, Notos.
(The moment Zephyrus approaches Notos, Notos's eyes, which were always smiling, turn sharp.)
Puck!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … ah?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … Phew, I finally feel refreshed now.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Ugh… . I never thought he would throw his fist like this without warning.
(Notos looks satisfied and extends his hand to the fallen Zephyrus.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Come on, wake up. my little brother I think I've sorted out all my old feelings with this... .
(Zephyros grabs Notos' hand, pretends to get up, and then hits him with his shoulder. Notos is then pushed back and falls.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … This bastard. How dare you ask your brother to do it?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Do you think I'm just suffering? We're only 2 minutes apart, but I guess you really want to hear my brother's voice that much?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, wait a minute… .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Then let’s do something!! My little brother!!
Sting. Purr.
(The moment Notus and Zephyrus are about to rush towards each other, small birds fly between them as if to stop them.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ugh, stop it.
(The birds flutter around Notos and Zephyrus, then stop. Then they start chirping noisily again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What, what is it?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyrus, you felt it too, right?
(Zephyros nods.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, do you know these birds? They're too scared to fly from the West to the East. But why here… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Did something happen in the canyon?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I already have a reason to go to the canyon.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: So you came with %s. %s, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I was so happy to see my younger brother after such a long time that I was rude to %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I understand.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Thank you for your understanding. Then can you tell me why you came to see me with Zephyrus?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, that's how it happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Notos briefly why you should go to Bayuna Canyon.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So I think I should go to Bayuna Canyon.
(Notos seems to be worried and calls out to Edam, who is returning from patrol from afar.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Edam County, Edam County.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Mr. Notos? Oh, %s is here too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Edam.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Mr. Edam, I will take some vacation time.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Yes? Suddenly?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Both brothers surprise the other by suddenly saying they will take a vacation.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's been a while since my younger brother came to visit, so I think I should go back to my hometown for a while. To be exact, it's near my hometown.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Ah, this person… .
(Edam looks at Zephyrus and nods as if he understands.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Please take care of the Nereid Gate until I return.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Yes, I understand. So when are you planning to leave?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: As the saying goes, “entrust your body to the wind that blows right now,” I’m planning to go now.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: Mr. Notos? Now is the intensive period for gateway inspection... … .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: We have already completed all document review and gate inspection to be sent to superiors. Edam County can do the rest.

lines.speaker: 에담
lines.text: It's amazing that you've already done all that.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I'll be back soon.
(Edam finishes talking with Notos about work and enters the center building.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I finished talking with Mr. Edam... . Let's go, %s.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, I didn't ask you to come with me.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyrus, you came to see me to get to Bayuna Canyon safely. He wants to ask me, the gateway officer, for personal use of the imperial facility.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's a request... .  Why do you say that?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Be quiet and follow me before I change my mind.
(Notus taps Zephyrus on the shoulder and smiles lightly. He then leads the way to the gateway.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . Zephyrus, let's go to the gateway.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Okay. I can't help it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, Notos-sama’s smile looks evil today….)
(Notos approaches the gate that was not open and looks around.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I guess I can use this. The surrounding magical power has stabilized, and there is no problem with the gate... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Why are you so stiff?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: This is the face it used to be.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Could you please avoid that expression with the same face as mine?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Don't worry too much, because one of these gates can be used at will with the center director's authority.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It was something like that. somehow… . As Notos said, we can use this gate.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You can use it right away, but there is a slight problem.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Problem?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Information on the magic power flowing through Bayuna Canyon may not be updated for a long time, so you may not arrive at the exact spot.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Magical forces gather in the places people visit, whether they know it or not. The gate recognizes the magical power gathered in that place and sends people there... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Should I say that the probability of arriving accurately in places that are not often visited, such as bayou or canyons, is low even if you use the gate? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Surely it won't fall into the middle of the sea?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It won't fall where it isn't on the road.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You can go back a little bit, but... .
Sting. Sting.
(Small orange birds fly around Notos and Zephyrus. Some of them land on their shoulders.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fascinating. These birds approach the two people without hesitation and sit down... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It reminds me a little of when I was young. Whenever we came out in front of our house, these birds would always fly around my brother.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Then my mother distributed things that could be used as food for the birds... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It seems like it was a place with good memories.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: After my mother passed away, I went to Glaston with my father... . Even my father... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, let’s stop talking about old times and let’s go.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yeah. I have to go.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, you don't have to worry too much because Zephyrus and I are here.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … Don't say strange things, Notos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… . I feel reassured that the two of you are going together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm worried that we'll fight again, but...)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I will go in first.
(Notos steps into the gate first, followed by Zephyrus.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's amazing to see the two of you together.  It'll be okay since they're brothers... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then should I go too?
Sting. Sting.
(With the chirping of birds, the flow of magical energy contained in the gate disperses. And as a bright light approaches and disappears, a new place comes into view.)
(The rock, which is so high that it touches the sky, presents a large and majestic shadow to visitors.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Bayuna Canyon.
(Zephyros is speechless at the sight of the place he arrived at.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyrus, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I thought I'd end up near the canyon, but I never thought I'd end up here.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, do you see that little house over there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a small and cozy house.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: This is the house where my brother and I lived with our parents when we were young.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: My parents' magic tools are still at home, so the gate's magic may have led us here.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's been a while here.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Is this your first time here since that incident?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What about Notos?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I came here a few days after leaving the Magic Agency. I just couldn't understand why you were so cruel to me and Chloris.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: So, I decided to gather my thoughts and pack my bags before heading to the Tower of the Wise. Now that I think about it, several years have already passed. Is it only 3 years or 4 years?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's been 3 years.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It doesn't matter whether it's 3 years or 4 years. Now tell me what you discovered during that time.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: What was the Magic Agency planning... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Wait, did you know what I was going to do?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Did you want me to show it off like that and pretend not to notice? Phew… .
(Notos sighs and looks at Zephyrus.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: There is a degree of treating brothers who even have similar souls as fools.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I'm sorry. okay. Let me talk.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Okay. As we talk, I keep saying sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The two people had faith in each other...)
(Zephyrus tells Notos about what he has investigated.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It was like that. It was hard. My little brother… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It wasn't like hard work... . but… .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: There's no need to blame yourself. Oh, then I'll tell you my story too.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The reason I went to the Wise Man’s Tower was to find my father’s research materials. No matter how much the Magic Agency does, they can't touch the Wise Man's Tower.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So what did you find?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You know the goal your father had when he was young, right?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: He wanted magic to be used for the public, not just for wizards.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: So, using his specialty, wind magic, he read the flow of the wind and gathered the magic power to create a crystal.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Using that crystal, ordinary citizens can easily move tools, machines, and facilities that require magical power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Wait a minute, Notos. I think I've seen a case like this somewhere... . Surely, Luria Village?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That's right, %s. It was operated on a pilot basis in Luria Village and gradually spread.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That was the result of my father's research and I had no idea... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: When my father went to the Ministry of Magic, he probably hoped that his research would help the residents live a better life.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The residents of Luria village seemed satisfied.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If nothing else, I'm glad... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It is a village that the Princess and Her Majesty frequently visit, so even the Ministry of Magic will not be able to easily touch it. Still, you have to be careful... .
Sting.
(Suddenly, small birds grab their collars and struggle to fly forward.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: What, what?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It seems like he's asking me to go somewhere... . for a moment… . Notos, %s, look over there.

steps.name: Explore Bayuna Canyon
steps.objective: Talk to [Notos] in “Bayuna Canyon.” Then, kill [East Wind Silfin] and [West Wind Silfin], and report the quest to [Zephyros] in “Bayuna Canyon.”

lines.text: (In the direction Zephyrus pointed, the wind vortex in the center of the canyon is making a loud noise and repeatedly getting louder and smaller.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's a whirlpool in the canyon... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I've never seen anything like that... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … The whirlpools we've seen here have always been relaxing, but today is different. It feels like a sharp knife... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The purpose of my coming here is to check what is happening here. You two, it could be dangerous, so stay here.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: If I wanted to stay still, I wouldn't have come here. Now that I'm here, I plan to do something.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Since you're here together, don't even dream of solving it on your own.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If the two people really mean it... . Okay, then let me guide you.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Although Bayuna Canyon is rough, you can avoid the whirlpools by following the designated path.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: When I was young, I used to play around the canyon with Notos. I know most of the paths, so just follow them.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: How about going to the front of the Mushroom Tree Swamp?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of place is it?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's a place where there are precious mushrooms and monsters who eat those mushrooms.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Then, shall we go to the front of the swamp?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah, %s. Let’s go with Zephyrus first. I will take a moment to gather my things from home and follow you.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Okay. I'll go first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Notos, I will go and wait for you. Oh, you went inside the house.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyrus, just wait there. Don't run away this time.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew, I got it. %s, let's go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha, shall we go then?

steps.name: Reunion with an uninvited guest
steps.objective: Talk to [Zephyros] in “Bayuna Canyon.” Then, defeat [Red Berserker] and [Dazed Agoste], and report the quest to [Little Blue Bird] in “Bayuna Canyon”.

lines.text: (Arriving in front of the Mushroom Tree Swamp, Zephyrus defeats the monster that chased him and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew… . It's definitely strange. Monsters that never existed before appear, and there are also traces of demons... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Moreover, it feels like even the birds called bobby pins are attacking us.
Sting. Sting.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: These birds that followed us from the Nereid Gate seem to say no... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral is nowhere to be seen.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I'm sure it's nearby. hmm… . That guy by the way.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: He was a disciple of Jiscard, a superman called the Sword Saint, but became corrupted, went in and out of the demon world, and helped summon the twisted people of Eastland... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What is the purpose? ?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not sure, but I can only guess that he wanted to become a superhuman.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: He seems like a person I know roughly. You want power, but you're not satisfied with mere power.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I won't stop until I get the strength I'm satisfied with. I won't be able to stop anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If someone forces you to stop….)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There are already many doors connected to the Demon World on the Continent of Preios, so it will be good to get exactly what you want.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: This isn't important, so let's talk about it later. %s, this is the road to the Mushroom Tree Swamp.
(In the direction Zephyrus pointed, large mushrooms of various colors are standing toward the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Mushrooms grow as big as trees... . It feels a little strange.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yeah? Maybe it's because Notos and I played there when we were kids, but I feel like it's just a mushroom.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So I was a bit surprised to see people calling it a mushroom tree.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right, Zephyrus. Oh, there you are, Mr. Notos.
(The small orange bird also seems to know this and flies towards Notos as if to welcome him.)
Sting. Sting.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, was everything okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not yet.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So what did you bring?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: When I came home the other day, I remembered that there was a strange note written in the note my father left... . I brought you something from my father.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: He told me that if something difficult happens in the canyon, I should take something out of a magically sealed box.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .
(Notos shows Zephyrus and %s a small crystal hovering in blue light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's some kind of spirit stone.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I was about to take this and go up the canyon, but a lizard man appeared from nowhere and chased me. So I had a bit of trouble solving it.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Phew. But when I moved with this, the barrier around the house weakened. I guess the house was safe thanks to the barrier created by my father's magic tools.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Somehow. There was a time when empty houses without people were gone, but there was a reason why they remained until now.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Wait… . Now that I see it, the power contained in that spirit stone... .
(Notos nods quietly.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, can you feel the power contained in this spirit stone?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, slightly? Is it the power of the wind? .
Sting. Sting. Sting!!

(The sound of a small bird echoes in the ears of %s, who was looking at the spirit stone. When he turns around in surprise, he makes eye contact with someone he does not want to meet in front of the entrance to the mushroom tree swamp.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Bara… .

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I thought you'd be here, but I didn't expect to see you so soon.
(Baral's eyes naturally turn to the blue spirit stone in Notos' hand.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Oh, there's what I'm looking for.
(With Baral's words, dozens of Lizardmen appear behind him. Then, the feeling of the air from the entrance to the mushroom tree swamp changes.)
(The moment he tries to strengthen his hand holding the weapon, a cute little blue bird flies in front of %s. And it meets %s's eyes)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Blue bird?
(At that moment, the cries of other birds, who seem to have followed the bluebird, begin to fill the canyon.)

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. Sting! Sting!! Guys, stab the demons!

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Wow, it's noisy. What on earth are these birds?
(Baral stretches out his hand and pushes away the birds flying from somewhere. However, the more he pushes away, the more they rush towards Baral and the Lizardmen.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: You idiots!! Don't stand still, catch and destroy all these birds!!
(At Baral's angry voice, the Lizardman swings his weapon and chases the bird away. Baral hurriedly pushes them away and comes forward, but what he found was already gone.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I thought it would be easy, but it ran away.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I can't help it. We'll meet again anyway, but should we do something before that? Hey, demons!! There's a lizard man!!
(The Lizardman chasing the birds focuses on Baral’s gesture.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: You stupid lizards, go tell your boss. Turn the canyon, this mushroom field, everything into a wasteland as much as you want.

steps.name: Following the bluebird
steps.objective:
1. Follow where the [Little Blue Bird] flew in 「Bayuna Canyon」.
2. After the story is over at “Sylphid's Rest” at the end of the canyon, report the quest to [Zephyros] in “Bayuna Canyon.”

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. Sting.
(The blue bird that was flying ahead stops moving, and the group that was running away from Baral behind them stops moving.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The demons won't be able to chase me this far.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It went deep into the canyon... . Thanks to this bird, I can take a breather.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if it was because of his mood, but I think this bird clearly told the other birds to attack the demons.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting?!
(The blue bird seems a little surprised.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Didn’t you mishear because the situation was so urgent?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There's no way a bird could talk. No, I don't know if it's a spirit. Ah, that's the Owl Clock Spirit. It's slightly different.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: What is an owl clock? Oh, that's right. Among the stories I heard from my father was something like this. There is a spirit among my friends.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I think I said it looked like this bird here.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting?!
(The blue bird is startled, but quickly pretends nothing is wrong.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This bird reacts to the words of the two people... I think it's a real spirit...)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I thought my father was just making up a story... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It means you received a spirit stone from a spirit. Is this really true?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Then ask the owl clock spirit. If it's my question, then answer... .
(The blue bird that makes eye contact with Zephyrus flaps vigorously with its small, invisible wings. However, not long after, it falls to the ground.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What is it? What's wrong with this bird?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … Wait, wait. You seem to have no energy.
(The moment Notos tries to look at the fallen bluebird, the bluebird comes to its senses, opens its eyes and flies away.)

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting!
(The bluebird flutters and flies into the canyon as if escaping.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When I try to touch it, it runs away.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Let’s chase that spirit.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's so slow that I think I can easily catch up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, was it a spirit?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That blue bird, no matter who sees it, it’s a spirit. I flinch while pretending it's not happening.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: The energy of the wind flowing from that bird matches the energy of this spirit stone. This energy follows that spirit.
(Zephyros and Notos make expressions as if asking why they are asking such an obvious question.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's follow along and talk.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. Guys, you can't come this far. I wish I could help you this much. Let's get some rest now.
(The blue bird hurries to a secret place in the canyon and sits down. Then, it turns slightly and gently closes its eyes.)

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. Why is my spirit stone there? No way, being a father… . And how do humans know Kronos?

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. Ah, spirits can know humans. ha… . I need to sleep. But I'm curious. Ah, I can't sleep like this.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting!! I can't sleep!!
(As the bluebird screams and flaps its wings, it makes eye contact with the approaching %s group.)

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: … Sting?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Don't try to imitate an ordinary, small bird that's bigger than the big rock you see over there.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. Oops. When I rest, I have to make my body bigger.
(The blue bird seems to have finally realized the situation and quickly retreats. However, it is stopped by someone grabbing it from behind.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's fluffy. I want to be snuggled up and fall asleep.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. How did humans get here? And you… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, spirit.
(The large blue bird spirit raises its head toward the sky after being greeted by %s.)

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. uh? Why do I hear the voice of a goddess when I look at you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris?

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. all right. Goddess. The human here is the goddess. Are you coming back later? no. There is no need to come to a squalid place... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That's fascinating. For a spirit to greet the goddess like this... .

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. The conversation with the goddess is over. You were able to come here because you were blessed by the goddess.

lines.speaker: 파랑새?
lines.text: Sting. I am Sylphid, the spirit king of wind who protects western Freios. Nice to meet you. %s.
(When the giant blue bird spirit introduces himself as Sylphid, Notos, Zephyrus, and %s also briefly introduce themselves.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Looks like you have a lot to tell me.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The Spirit King of Wind... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Let's talk with Silphid.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Sylphid Spirit King, do you know my father, Nemo? My father had your spirit stone.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting… . That's right, square. He was the only human I recognized. He gave a spirit stone as a token of friendship. I told you to come to me with a spirit stone if something difficult happens... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Wow, now that I think about it, these two people look like squares. Erenis looks similar too. I can tell by looking at your eyes.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Is Nemo okay? It seems like it's been a while since I haven't seen Erenis since she passed away. I said I was going to the capital... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah… , you didn’t know. My father passed away in an accident 10 years ago.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting?! really? Now, wait a minute. If Nemo passed away, there's no way I wouldn't have known... . Surely in the capital… ?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes, I was checking something at the Ministry of Magic in the capital city of Glaston when I got into an accident... .
(Sylphid looks into space for a long time, as if in disbelief. Then, a large drop of water falls down Silphid's fur and onto %s's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, it's cold. Ah, Sylphid… .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. sorry.
(Sylphide shakes herself and shakes away the liquid from her eyes.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. There is no place on the continent where the wind does not reach. If you go through the spirits, you can most likely find out what's going on... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. But I can't feel what's happening in Glaston. But I can't go to Glaston.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: There must be spirits in Glaston too, right?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It must be there, but I don't know why. Phew… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Sylphide, my father is buried in the parkland cemetery in Glaston.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Thank you, square children. Now that I know where it is, I'll go.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Thank you. Sylphid Spirit King... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The person named Nemo seems to have been a good person enough for the Spirit King to trust...)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Thank you. Sylphide. But how did you get to know your father?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. On the way back to rest, my body became weak and I lost consciousness, but I was caught in a demon's trap. How did Nemo know and save us when we were so close to extinction?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I said thank you without realizing it, and it turned out I was a spirit. That led to my meeting Elenis.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. As we got closer, I tried to give him a nice gift, but he refused. So I told the benefactor that the spirit would disappear if I did not give him the blessing, and only then did he receive it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is the first time I have heard of a spirit disappearing like that.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Half right and half wrong. Anyway, I gave the spirit stone to Nemo and Erenis, and the blessing of wind to you two.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Nemo said that if he was going to give a blessing, he would ask the children to do it.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I see. So the coming wind was always warm. Thank you, Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I felt good about wind magic from the beginning. Thank you too.
(When Notos and Zephyrus said thank you, Sylphid frowned as if she was satisfied.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Nemo's kids are good guys after all.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A relationship like Narin and Io existed here too...)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I saved you guys a little while ago, but I used up all my strength chasing away the demons. I was already on my way back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's why you flew all the way here to recover.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Now, if I want to regain my strength, I need to stay as still as possible. So I made my body bigger.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. As your body grows, moving becomes a hassle. So it’s easier to rest.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's kind of true, but it's a little weird... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Is that so? No matter what you do, you have to recover quickly to protect the canyon. Strangely, after being caught in a trap, you can't escape the canyon.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: If you are the Spirit King of Wind, do you know about whirlpools?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Whoa, that whirlpool. It's long, so I'll explain briefly. That's it. It didn't occur naturally.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It wasn't there from the beginning... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Was it 10 years ago? Was it 20 years ago? One day, a strong wind suddenly rose in the middle of the canyon and formed a whirlpool like that.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. If it were a normal wind, I could put it to rest, but that's not just that.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. The flow of magical energy around Freios burst and erupted from Bayuna Canyon.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. At first, I tried to put it to sleep somehow. Even if I use all my power, it only decreases a little.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. After a while, it goes back to normal. I used up all my strength and had no choice but to rest again.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I'm leaving it alone for now. I don't think anything big will happen right away, and I don't think I'm going to keep using my strength... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Whenever I run out of strength, the demons always come. Phew.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how it happened.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Anyway, I have a lot of work to do. Just because you're resting doesn't mean you're not doing anything.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. The demons always come here and are looking for something, but I don't know what it is.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. The only thing you can take from the bayou or canyon is mushrooms.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyrus, do you remember what that man said when he saw us?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What did you say? for a moment… .
(Notos and Zephyrus remember what Baral said, as if they had made a promise to each other.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … I thought you'd be here... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I never thought we would meet so soon. What you were looking for was there.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … He clearly said this. What on earth is that... . Ah,

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you really aiming for Sylphid's spirit stone?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. That spirit stone is a token given only to people I recognize, nothing more, nothing less.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … So, what is it? hmm… .
(When a large bird and three people put their heads together and guess Baral's purpose, many birds fly above the quiet canyon sky.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What, what is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not dozens, but hundreds... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Bobbin usually doesn't ask for help... . I'm suffering. I have to go… .
(Sylphide tries to move quickly but loses balance and rolls forward.)
Boom.
(The rolling Silphid stops only after hitting the rock in front of it.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silphid, are you okay? uh?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Scream. It's a bit far from getting back in shape, but I'll give it a try... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Silphid, I think it would be best to rest.
(Zephyros examines the condition of the fallen Sylphid with both hands.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. You guys seem to have suddenly grown bigger?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That's not it, Sylphid has become smaller.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting?!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I think it's because the demons were blown away while they weren't properly recovered. What should I do with this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Notos and Zephyrus. Would you like to stay with Silphid for a moment? I'll go and take a look.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. sorry.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, I'm going too. It seems like there are too many of you two here, and I think I can go. Notos, listen to the spirit king.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Because since ancient times, birds have liked Notos more than me.
(Zephyros hands over the Sylphid he was holding to Notos.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: That's true, but do you mind if I don't come with you?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If the Spirit King becomes dangerous, the wind flow in the western part of the continent will also become strange. So, it's true that someone is guarding this place.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Sylphid Spirit King, stay here with me. I'm probably a little more trustworthy than that guy. Because I'm your older brother.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Even if he dies soon, he is still my brother... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Then I can focus on recovery as well. Oh, I'm not saying give it to you and then take it away, just put my spirit stone over there for a moment.
(Notos gently places the spirit stone in the place pointed to by Sylphid. Then Sylphid flaps its small wings and flies down on top of it.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I'll close my eyes here for a moment. Notos, if demons come, think about the wind blowing from the south.
(With those words, Silphid closes her eyes on the blue spirit stone.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It’s the south wind… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, I'll be back, so I'm waiting here with the Spirit King.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back, Notos.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, let's go.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Okay, %s. Then please take care of Zephyrus.

steps.name: signs of unpleasant moisture
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Zephyros] in “Bayuna Canyon” and enter “Mushroom Tree Swamp.” 
2. Defeat [Yankas] in “Mushroom Swamp” and report the quest to [Zephyros] in “Bayuna Canyon.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Phew… .
(Zephyros looks at the mushroom monster lying at his feet and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: This monster rarely comes out of the swamp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … The fact that it came out... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: When this monster meets people, it chases after them, but when it sees the outside, it returns to the swamp.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I often said that even if I was attacked by a demon, I would never leave the house because I hated it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is Baral inside?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I don't know what kind of power Baral has, but I don't think it's that much.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Ah, %s. Look here.
(There is a small soot mark on the arm of the monster that Zephyrus is pointing to.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Is it a burn mark?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I heard that some demons spray black fog in a certain area when brainwashing external beings, and it seems similar.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They're definitely not ordinary demons... . %s, what's wrong?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral is standing in front of a large mushroom in the distance.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Did you come to meet us alone? %s, wait a minute. wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Seeing that he came out alone, it looks like he has something to say. I should go and listen to it. Of course, I won't tell you everything.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I know what you mean. You better be fully prepared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let's go into the swamp when we're ready.
(After just walking a few steps, a new place with a different atmosphere from the canyon unfolds before your eyes.)
(As a sticky feeling envelops your entire body, an uninvited guest waiting in front walks out with an unbecoming smile on his face.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Baby, it ran away a little while ago, but now it's crawling out. Where did you hide that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that’s the case… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I don't know what you want, but it won't work out the way you want.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I guess you know it anyway, but you want to hear it from my mouth?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Give me the spirit stones you guys have. Then I'll spare your life.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I recognized that it was no ordinary stone.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you going to use it for... .

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: If you want to know, take me down. Before Yankas ruins the Mushroom Swamp and Canyon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yancas?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Yankas is one of the candidates for the commander of the Demon World Corps. It's just as cruel as Weiss, and this time it was specially given to Lux at the witch's request.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: I heard he betrayed another guy and joined Lux. Is that true? I wonder if someone who betrayed him once can't betray him again... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is a story about you who completely wants to betray your teacher and do bad things? Vice, a witch, and the demon lord Lux... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You gave up on humanity.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: What I do has nothing to do with you, right?
(With Baral's words, the chains wrapped around his arms are released and he flies towards %s. However, he repels %s's attacks as if nothing had happened.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That won't work, Baral.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: If it doesn't work, you have to make it happen.
(Contrary to what he said, Baral frowned. He tried attacking again several times, but he felt like he was being crushed by %s's momentum, which was different from before.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: (That man named Baral is also beyond a normal human, but %s's movements... are beyond a human compared to when he dealt with me before...)
Boom.

(Baral is hit by %s's attack and falls down after hitting a rock. He takes his stance and tries to attack again. However, he stops his action when he sees the tip of %s's weapon in front of his eyes.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come on, say it now. What do you want here... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: (That guy, there’s something strange….)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Huh, I can't help it. I just came here to receive a request. What the witch who hired me wants... .

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: It is the disappearance of the Spirit King in Bayuna Canyon. And I told him to go find the spirit stone because it was near Bayuna Canyon.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I don't know why the witch wants the spirit to disappear. A witch good enough to hire you wouldn't need spirit powers or anything like that.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: It's a witch's situation, you don't know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral, tell me who the witch is that hired you and what you get in return.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: When I went to the Demon World, it was just a favor I received from Lux. I don't know what kind of witch she is. And what I decided to receive was… .

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Do I even need to talk about this?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If you will go back with the demons you brought with you, I will spare your life.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: What should I do with this? My life is pretty tough.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?
(The moment Zephyrus looks around at Baral's words, dozens of Lizardmen who were hiding appear.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: For some reason, I thought he was hiding something... . But, that's about it.

(When Zephyrus opens the magic book, a large wind rises from beneath the feet of the Lizardmen who are approaching. The wind that rises like a whirlpool causes some of the Lizardmen to fly backwards.)
(Taking advantage of that opportunity, Baral enters the vortex as if ignoring Zephyrus' magic.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Baral, stop!!
(As soon as Baral turns around, he swings the chain wrapped around his arm. Zephyrus' magic and %s's attack follow once again, but they are all parried.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: It's not bad considering it matches well. Now, you guys have to deal with Yankas.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: A very cruel Lizardman who drinks blood after killing his opponent. That Yankas guy is now in the Mushroom Tree Swamp.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: He'll probably do as instructed and destroy the swamp and even the bayou and canyon.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: By then, the Spirit King will also appear... . Because spirits value the land where life exists.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hope!!
(%s's attack follows with all his might, but Baral counters it as if nothing happened.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: Now, take your pick. Will we stop Yankas from destroying the canyon, including the Mushroom Tree Swamp? Or will they chase after me to find the Spirit King?

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: No matter what you do, the Spirit King will appear in front of you. With all strength lost.
(With those words, dozens or hundreds of Lizardmen, unknown from where they came from, run towards the %s party.)

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: %s and wizard, hold out here if you can, and tell Yankas to come out alive.

lines.speaker: 바랄
lines.text: If only I could... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hope!!
(While the two are dealing with the group of Lizardmen, Baral's figure moves farther and farther out of the Mushroom Tree Swamp.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We have to deal with these guys first!
(The sharp wind created by Zephyrus flies into the arms of the Lizardman. %s's attack continues towards the Lizardman who tries to avoid it.)
(As even the one remaining Lizardman falls, Zephyros checks his condition.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I think this is enough... . %s… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, go and chase Baral. The spell I cast will still be valid, so if I take this tool with me... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyrus chases after Baral. I'll take care of Yankas here.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What do you mean? Are you going to fight all the monsters and demons in the swamp right now?
(Zephyros checks %s's expression and sighs.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Ha, I've already decided. I get it. I follow Baral. And I will buy time and prevent you from getting to Sylphid... . Meanwhile… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't worry too much. Because there's Iris behind me.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You have more reliable support than anyone else. Then hurry up.
(Zephyros laughs lightly and runs out of the swamp.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They clearly said that Yankas was a candidate for corps commander. Then, rather than the corps commander I faced before... … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let’s go without thinking about unnecessary things. No opponent will be easy.
(While crossing the swamp, %s is attacked by monsters that inhabit the swamp, including lizardmen from the demon world.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... . There's no end in sight.
(Finally, a large shadow falls in front of %s, who was catching his breath after defeating the last attacking monster.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … huh?
The teacher wants to see the end. If so... .
(The moment the owner of the large shadow raises his arm, a strong force rushes in and shines with blue light. The light rises into the sky with the owner of the shadow and then falls to the ground.)
Kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwa-kwak!
(A huge explosion occurs on the ground with a loud noise due to a massive attack.)
You managed to avoid it, sir.
(As the water mist rising from the swamp gradually disappears, a large and strong-looking being appears in the field of view of %s, who is adjusting his posture.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I almost got hit and flew away...)
You showed composure even when looking at the enemy commander. I would like to praise your attitude.
(A large lizardman, about three to four times the size of a human, wears sharp, tough-looking heavy armor and gauntlets as large as his body.)
Did you hear my story from Baral? If so, you probably have some idea of ​​who the director is.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yankas... .

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: The warden says it's Yankas.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: A general who will fill the position of corps commander that became vacant due to the teacher's performance.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: What does the teacher want from the warden? It's probably an obvious answer anyway, but I'll listen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (He pretends to be polite, but he speaks in a way that makes him look down on the other person. The way he speaks is different, but he is similar to someone else, and who is that... It's strangely annoying...)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Go ahead and say it. Are you just buying time?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yankas, take your men and leave the canyon. immediately.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Teacher, listen carefully. If what you say suits the director's work, I will gladly step down... .
(Yankas raises his arm and licks the red stain on the gauntlet with his tongue.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Since this is not suitable, the warden must do as the lord commands.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what did Lux ask you to do?

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Sir, please do not mention my lord’s name in vain. Ha, now that I think about it, I guess I kept you alive for a long time... .
(In an instant, Yankas's eyes become sharp and the huge gauntlet falls to the ground again.)
Boom.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: You've already avoided me, a rat-like person... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As expected, it shows its true colors. Demon Yancas.
(Yankas looks at Adventurer, who dodged the attack with his gauntlet. He then flicks his tongue and begins to taste.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: It's been a while since I've had the chance to drink real human blood. Until now, I've only drank tasteless blood... .

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Surely, if you are a human being who has received God's protection, wouldn't it be a bit different even if the taste of blood was different?

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Now, teacher. Please be willing to become a sacrifice for me, who will become the commander of the corps!!
Boom.
(Yankas receives a blow from %s and is pushed backwards. He tries to adjust his posture again, but falls down.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Ugh… .
(He tries to stand up using a large mushroom as a walking stick, but he slips and can't hold on properly.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Oh my... medical charge… . Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yankas, you know you don’t stand a chance, right?

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell me what Lux told you to do.
(Yankas, who was coughing up blood, looks at %s's face and starts laughing.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Kkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkkk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, why are you smiling?

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: I think teachers are human after all... . Because demons tend to cut off the neck or stab the heart if they have to. Sigh. Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Even in this situation, you are using your tongue.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: The director is a lizardman, so it's no wonder he uses his tongue. Cluck cluck.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: … I had no idea I could be defeated by a human like this.
(Yankas falls down and looks at the sky in silence.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: The teacher will knock you down and you will die anyway. I don't know if you can solve it, but I'll tell you.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: The lord won't even care about the warden, hahaha... .

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Teacher, there will soon be a door. Teacher, you already know what role that door will play.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way, the gate to the demon world... .

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: I don't know which of those doors will be. Sigh… . Cluck, cluck. To have vain hopes of becoming a corps commander with a role that barely buys time... .

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Ugh… … .

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: If it ends like this, I wonder if it was right to betray the Archduke. Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Archduke? They say he betrayed him, but he was under the Archduke... .

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Any other demon would have betrayed and tried to kill the warden, but he was different. Sigh.

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Anyway, the director... .
Boom!
(The moment Yankas is about to continue speaking, the sound of something large falling somewhere in the canyon is heard. And Yankas lets out a single scream.)

lines.speaker: 양카스
lines.text: Wow!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yankas, you saw me too easily… .
(The sharp dagger, which I don’t know when it was taken out, is deeply embedded in Yankas’ neck due to Adventurer’s counterattack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If your laughter hadn't been mixed in with the sounds coming from the canyon, I would have died... .
(After a while, Yankas' body is charred black and instantly turns into black ash. Then, it is carried away by the wind blowing over the mushroom swamp and flies away somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was there some kind of curse or something?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hehe, don't overthink it and let's go quickly. Since you said it was definitely a door, it must be the door to the demon world... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(Zephyros is rushing towards %s, who is catching his breath after finishing the battle with Yankas.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyrus?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There you are.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyrus, how did you find Baral?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The only way down the canyon is the main road over there, and it's a dead end... , disappeared as if it had evaporated.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By any chance, do you know of a shortcut?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Considering that you came all the way here knowing about the existence of Silphid, it's definitely not a lack of information.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: There is something bigger than that. That's why I came back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It looks like there are still lizardmen in the swamp, so let's talk after we leave the swamp.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Let's do that. Coincidentally, I also found out something from Yankas... .

steps.name: Spirit King's Illusion
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Zephyros] in “Bayuna Canyon” and go forward to the [Little Blue Bird]. 
2. Enter “Sylphid's Rest” to assess the situation, then return to [Little Bluebird] in “Bayuna Canyon” and report the quest.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Was he trying to buy time for the door to appear?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Trying to connect the passage to the Demon World to Freios was a constant thing. But this time I have an ominous feeling that something is different.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Hmm… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there a problem?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
