lines.text: I tried to go back to the place where Sylphid was, just in case, but I couldn't go in because of the barrier that suddenly unfolded.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: No matter what I did, I couldn't get past it on my own. ha… . So I had no choice but to find you again.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I think the reason I was able to enter the Spirit King’s realm was because you were with me.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You know the place where Silphid rested for a while? There was an illusion of Silphid nearby, so I tried to talk to it, but there was no answer.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I think it's probably because it's not the main body.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyros, I need to check Sylphid's illusion first.
(Zephyros nods his head at %s’s words and runs ahead.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I hope nothing happens to you two...)
(In the place where Silphid was, a small Silphid is floating in the air without any movement.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: As Zephyros said, there is no sign of welcome from Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Right?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Normally, an illusion would move according to the will of the main body, but there must be a reason why it doesn't move like this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, let’s go. Hurry up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Oh, by the way, what is that thing in the direction that Sylphid’s illusion is facing?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Is there something there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I think you saw it wrong. Zephyrus, let’s go quickly.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, Sylphid!!
(Zephyros follows %s into the place where Sylphid was resting. He calls out a loud voice for everyone.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lord Notos, Lord Sylphid!

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Where have they both gone?
(As the two people were looking around, the small birds that Sylphid called Silphins flocked in and sat somewhere.)
Sting. Sting!
(As the two people run to the loud chirping of birds, Notos is seen lying down with his hands outstretched between them.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos!! Notos, wake up!!

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Are you out of your mind?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Here… . Oh, that's right. This is where Silphid was… .
(Notus stands up with Zephyrus' support and looks around.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Notos, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I'm fine, but it looks like the Spirit King has been kidnapped.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Was Baral a bait? .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It happened so quickly that I couldn't even do anything.
(Notus lowers his head as if blaming himself.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's okay, Notos. Please let me know the situation. Only then can we go and rescue Silphid.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: A person who appeared to be a high-ranking demon with an unusually broken horn appeared and tried to take the Spirit King away. So I blocked it... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A demon with a broken horn?)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: He said he had no personal feelings, but he was hit by an arrow and lost consciousness... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think I had any intention of killing him. Fortunately, there are no injuries... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Do you remember anything else?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ah… . Lux said she wanted to take me to the door.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Door… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They used Baral as bait to lure us in, used Yankas to buy time, and kidnapped Sylphid... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I don't think I simply want Sylphid's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Since Silphid said that he is in charge of the wind west of Freios, are you trying to use that wind?
(At %s’s words, Notos and Zephyros look at each other as if they had made a promise.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, that's it!!

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Great job, %s!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The fall of Freios... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Simply eliminating the Spirit King does not mean that Freios falls immediately... .  Other spirits do that work instead.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: However, it would be a different story if the Spirit King, who influenced the lower-level spirits, gave orders directly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reason we took the Spirit King Silphid to the Demon World was brainwashing... … ?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I don't know the exact details, but I have no choice but to go and check.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: We need to find the door quickly. I have the spirit stone, so you will be able to find it soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I saw something down near where Silphid's illusion was. I guess I'll have to go there and check it out.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, Notos. Are you sure you're okay?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: You don't have to worry at all. It's stronger than it looks... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: While I wasn't watching, my useless bravado only increased. I'm glad you're okay, but don't push yourself too hard.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Haha, Zephyrus. After all, you are the only one who worries about me.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Haha… . %s, I'm sorry for bringing you here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I'm glad we get along well.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We get along well... . Let's stop talking like this and start looking for clues.

steps.name: remember the inquiry
steps.objective:
1. Go to “Lysithea’s Gate” from where the [Little Blue Bird] is in “Bayuna Canyon.” 
2. Defeat [Andrea] at 「Lysithea's Gate」 and obtain <Shiny Key Bundle>. Then, return to [Little Bluebird] in “Bayuna Canyon” and report the quest.

lines.text: (The three people return the way they came and arrive at the place where the illusion of Sylphid is. The illusion is still floating in the air without moving.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Sylphide has created an illusion of herself here. I think they probably left a trace so we could come back... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I can't see anything around that could be called a door.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The door hasn't disappeared already, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think there is a path in the direction the illusion is looking.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: As %s said, the energy flowing from the spirit stone... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Wait, %s. Let's go together. Oh, it's already gone.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyrus, that road… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Right… .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Our family often enjoyed picnics… .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yeah... .
(At the end of the road where Zephyrus and Notos arrived after chasing %s, there was a suspicious structure built that did not fit the canyon at all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a door that looks suspicious to anyone.
(The moment you look up from the burning torches on either side of the door, your eyes meet a decoration that appears to be the head of a horned devil.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: In the case of Degos, he used something like his old mansion, but it looks like he has no intention of hiding the fact that the space inside this door is a demon world.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Seeing the blue feathers falling, it looks like Sylphid is also inside. As expected, the spirit stone reacts.
(A small wind rises around the Sylphid spirit stone in Notos' hand.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Moreover, there is even a barrier made of magical power.
(Zephyrus extends his hand, but the door does not allow him and pushes him away.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I think it will take some time to dismantle this... . uh?
Sigh.
(The door that was firmly closed beyond the barrier is pushed inward by the hand of %s, creating a gap large enough for a person to enter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The door opened. I just followed Zephyrus and reached out... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What should I say about this… . It's clearly the gate to the demon world, but if it reacts to a person who has received God's protection... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyrus, let's think about that later and go ahead.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It could be dangerous, so I'll take the lead for now. Please wait here for a moment.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let’s go inside….)
(The moment you step through the gap in the door, a world with a completely different atmosphere from the canyon just moments before unfolds before your eyes.)
(In the darkness of nothing, countless stars are twinkling in the distance. And only one person, %s, who opened the door and entered the middle of it, stands and looks at the scene.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is here? I feel strange just looking at it... .
(As I was walking little by little to find a place that felt both mysterious and lonely, unseen things slowly approached %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What, what?
(Things that were thought to shine like stars take shape as they get closer.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Door?
(What you see in front of you are various types of doors of various sizes and colors. Such doors float in a space-like space, catching %s's attention.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are open doors and closed doors... . Oh, this is not the time to be admiring the scenery.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Silphid. Silphid, where are you?

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Sting? %s? I am here. Get it out of here quickly.
(As %s calls out for Silphid, Silphid's voice is heard from somewhere.)
(Sylphid's voice is heard in the space outside the door, but she is not seen at all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir Sylphid, where are you?

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Sting. A demon with a broken horn suddenly attacked and kidnapped me here. They opened a big door and locked me in. Oops, the door won't open.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sir Silphid, there are more than just one or two doors like that.

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Sting?

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Sting. How many doors are there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There are more than thirty that I can see in front of me right now. please wait for a moment.

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Sting! Sting!! As soon as you meet this demon, you will be stabbed!!
(Sylphid continues to scream as if she is angry. At that moment, one of the dozens of doors in front of her opens, and someone slowly walks out from between them.)
(Every time a sturdy young man with red horns takes a step forward, a rattling sound is heard from the shackles on his feet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Demon? The horn is broken... Oh, is it that demon?)
There is a human who entered the gates of Lysithea on his own… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If you return Silphid, I will return quietly.
Sylphide? Is that the name of the Spirit King?

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Sting? %s, is that demon here? Yes, this guy, how dare the Spirit King... .
It's noisy, Spirit King.
(The demon youth creates a sharp arrow with his fingertips. Then, he puts it on the bow he is holding and sends it flying into the air.)
(The arrows separate into several pieces and fall towards all the doors. Then, the sound of doors locking is heard one after another.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you doing now?
It's much quieter.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … What are you talking about? ah… !
(Sylphid's voice can no longer be heard. Moreover, all sounds coming into this space are also filled with silence, as if all have been blocked.)
With this, all doors are locked.
(He tries to hurry back after hearing the words of the young demon with a broken horn, but he cannot go because he is blocked by an unknown wall.)
This is the gate of Lysithea. I thought you would know about this space if you came here on your own, but I guess not.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gate of Lysithea?
It is a space created by the twisted person for himself. Now, it has become a place where everything that can be restrained is confined and managed by the Demon World.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Who are you?
I guess you don't know me because I'm a human. I'm Andrea. He is a manager who lives trapped here.
(A demon youth who introduced himself as Andrea stares at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you explain that you were trapped and came out of the door and took the Spirit King with you?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: That's what I want to know too... . Why did the door open in the canyon where the Spirit King was... . Anyway, I just brought the Spirit King as Lux requested.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you Lux's subordinate?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Did you see me as Lux's subordinate? Think whatever you want. And the Spirit King definitely wants you %s… , I think it's called that. %s?
(At that moment, a large amount of ridicule appeared on Andrea's face, which had been quiet. It was like joy, as if she had seen what she had been waiting for.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: If you came here on your own, I knew you were not an ordinary human.
(As soon as Andrea finishes speaking, she creates an arrow with her fingertips and hangs it on the bow.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't want to fight now... .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: It's noisy.
(Andrea's arrow is aimed at %s's head. A door in the air breaks with a loud sound.)
(In the blink of an eye, Andrea stands on top of the broken door and looks down.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Prove it once.
(Andrea turns her back and enters the broken door. And leaves behind meaningful words.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Will you be able to get out of here? Otherwise, you will be trapped forever without knowing why.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Andrea, stop right there!!
(Leaving behind the cries of %s, Andrea enters the broken door. After a while, the door that seems to have swallowed Andrea disappears as if evaporating.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't go back, I can't chase after Andrea... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: In the end, you have to open all of these doors and find whatever you want. I can't help it. I have no choice but to go… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, Sylphid... .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I opened all the doors... .
(Andrea smiles lightly when she sees %s coming through the door.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Most of the doors couldn't be opened because there was no key, and most of the doors couldn't be pushed even if you pushed with your strength... .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: It's not normal to even open the manager's door. I'll praise you.
(As Andrea lightly waves her hand, the Hellfire chasing Adventurer retreats.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why am I bitten? Are you taking your time?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I'd like to talk for a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Talk here? I don't know what proof you're talking about, but let me tell you if I did it.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: You have an impatient personality. If you want, I can tell you what you need... .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Even if you don't like it, you have no choice. From the moment the door is closed, there is nothing you can open with your hands.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Looking at the reaction, it looks like there is room for negotiation. So let's just say I've half-proved it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, okay. If you're not Lux's subordinate, why are you following Lux's instructions?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I want this. It's too direct... .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: As in any world, only the strong survive in the Demon World. So, in order to become the best, they constantly try to prove themselves by defeating the weak and the strong.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: My brother and I killed all the other demons that attacked us to survive. And it got stronger. These red horns are like proof.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I felt alive during the fight, but I guess it wasn't my brother.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: If they had done just a little more, they could have defeated Lux and ruled the demon world... .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Even if you look like you don't understand, I can't help it. Demons live like that. That's the rule of the demon world.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: My younger brother did not follow those rules and ran away. I didn't even leave a message where I went. Well, I don't even want to know.

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Anyone who betrays Pandemonium becomes a target for everyone. How did I become the target of anger on behalf of my younger brother, who I don't even know where he went... .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I never thought I would be captured by Lux and locked in the gates of Lysithea. ha… . In an eternal space where no matter what you do, you come back... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you did what Lux told you to do?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: If you want to survive, you have to do as you're told. If you don't die, you can take revenge later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How can you say it's a place you can't leave forever?

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: That's a good question. Hehehe. It's not that there is no way.
(Andrea smiles lightly and quietly steps back. Then, she spreads her arms and introduces herself to the place where she is.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Because here comes the person who finds and opens the manager's door.
(Another space with many doors, one of which is shining brightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What is that door…?)
(Andrea, whether or not she knows there is a shining door, leaves only her own words to say.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Lysithea will be happy if I redeem you. This is a space where a being with God's protection is more suitable than me, a demon... .
(Andrea's gentle, dancing gestures create an arrow blazing with magic. The arrow is then caught on his red bow and aimed at %s.)
(%s also knows what Andrea's actions mean, so she quickly takes a alert posture.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Now, %s. Become the manager of this place for me. That's your fate for coming here... .
(An exhausted Andrea looks at %s who is just as exhausted.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Phew, he doesn't fall down easily. All you have to do is trap him as soon as he falls... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, ha... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (If things continue like this, we have no chance of winning. What should we do? Wait, that door?)
(At that moment, the still shining door catches %s's attention.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For some reason, I feel like I need to open that door... Okay, let's give it a try. It'll work out somehow.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I don't know what you're thinking, but there's nowhere for you to run from here.
(Andrea laughs lightly at %s's actions as if she is trying to run away towards one of the doors. And she creates an arrow bigger than the arrows she has made so far.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Okay, let's finish now. This is eternal redemption for you... … .
Bang!
(One of the tightly closed doors opens after being hit by a strong attack from %s.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I can't lose you just because a door that wasn't open opens... .
(The moment %s's figure heads toward the door, the arrow that was resting on Andrea's fingertip flies toward the door.)
(After a while, a loud sound penetrating something echoes through the space where there is only a door.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Gagging… .
(Andrea sees the arrow flying from behind her and sits down.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Oh my... medical charge… . how… .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: I couldn't open that door even with the key I had... . That… How did you open it... .
(Adventurer slowly walks out behind Andrea, who falls down and coughs.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well… .

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Cluck, cluck. God help you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, I'll take your keys.
(Andrea bites her lip and looks at Adventurer, who is holding a bundle of keys in her hand.)

lines.speaker: 안드레아
lines.text: Do whatever you want… . Cluck, cluck.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where is Silphid?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I just lost my mind. Phew. At this rate, even if he wakes up right away, he won't attack... .
(Adventurer looks around, leaving the unconscious Andrea behind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ha, I can't help it. Even if it's annoying, I have no choice but to open them all... .
(I try to open the door with all the keys in the key pack, but there is just a blocked space inside the door. There is no sign of Sylphid at all.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I opened everything, but where is Silphid? uh… .
Sting.
(At that moment, the chirping of a small bird can be heard through the door that was opened for the first time in the room. And the area around the door begins to glow brightly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Sir Sylphid?
Sting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is that door? Phew, you'll have to go in to find out.
(The moment you step inside, the lights disappear one by one, like stars floating in the air. And when the last remaining light disappears, the door you came in through closes with a loud sound.)
Ugh.
(An unknown sound fills the space. The light that disappeared along with the sound returns to illuminate someone.)
(The silhouette of a woman I see for the first time is sitting down in pain.)
Ugh.
(Among the strange sounds, a woman's screaming voice can be faintly heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where am I? I'm sure I came through the door, and who is that person over there? I'm saying something, but I can't hear you...)
Ugh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where are my hands? My face…? My feet…? And me?)
(As strange thoughts fill my head, strange sounds disperse little by little. And the previously unheard female voice gradually gets closer.)

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: I didn't run away... .

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: I was always watching from that spot. I didn't betray my life.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: I wanted to let the light stay in the new space. I was going to do it before he touched me... .

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Why... A moment of absurd chaos and darkness came over us, right?

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Our stars were created out of necessity. So it should never disappear by chance... .
(Someone calls the screaming woman’s name.)
Lysithea.

lines.speaker: 여성의 목소리
lines.text: Don’t call my name carelessly!!
(The woman called Lysithea is screaming and suffering. However, the voice calling for Lysithea just does not stop.)
Lysithea… … .

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Stars where life lives are not old and dirty. No matter how much the world you observe doesn’t meet your standards, you shouldn’t do anything rashly!!

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: ▒▒, ▒▒▒, and ▒▒▒▒ that I loved are all dead. You killed them all.

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: I will live to fight you. Even if I am trapped in the space I created and die trapped forever.

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: I will never live under the name you created as a twisted person!!
Ugh.

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: So you're going to make me an offer? So that he can be reborn and become a proper god? I want to stand in front of my loved ones again. That's not it.

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Do you think I will believe that?

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Agni fell, Ceres was driven out. Gaia also lost her strength and fell asleep. Even though the brothers and sisters we loved are dead... . you!!
(Lysithea's silhouette hovers around and then sits down.)

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: I have to live... . I want to live… . I have to stay alive and protect everyone. So don't bother me. Save me... .

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: I didn't do anything wrong... . Is it a sin to love this world... … ?

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Why do you keep calling me different names?
(Lysithea raises her head and stares somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Can I just accept the name Esnil?  I don't understand.

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: The world must be purified to eliminate all sins of living beings... .

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: So does this mean that the world that everyone wants and where no one suffers will come?

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Then… , then… . Being an Esnil is not bad... … … .
(At that moment, a black shadow gathers around Lysithea's silhouette and swallows everything in sight.)

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: Aaaaaaaaaaa!!

lines.speaker: 리시테아의 목소리
lines.text: … Sleeping chaos, don't wake up in the deep darkness and take me away... . This world is not yours.
(With those words, black shadows, including silhouettes, disperse. And Lysithea's voice is no longer heard.)
(And a pain unprecedented in the world burrows into %s’s head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaaaa!!

lines.speaker: 실피드의 목소리
lines.text: Sting. Wake up, %s. I stab you once more... ?
(In front of %s, a small blue bird approaches with its small wings flapping and appears ready to attack.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silphid!!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. You're awake. thank god. I thought you wouldn’t wake up!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I'm fine, but are you okay?
(Sylphid says sorry and pats %s's head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thanks to you, I feel better.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. thank god. But how do you know Lysithea?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. You fell down and mumbled something strange. Lysithea doesn't like being called Esnil.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Lysithea is a god who disappeared during the Twilight Age, and Esnir is a twisted person who cursed the gods and disappeared... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. What the hell did you see, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Silphid everything from the moment I opened the door and saw Lysithea's silhouette.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting… .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting… . I never thought Lysithea's memories would remain here... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting… . Lysithea... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened to the god Lysithea?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I'm not sure. If this space was meant to show Lysithea's memories, there must be a reason.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Sylphide.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I wish only Iris knew about Lysithea. I guess it's because it's a story about God.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Just tell Nemo’s children that you found me safely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I know what you mean.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. %s, let's get out now. Oh, take care of that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where do we go? I opened all the closed doors and now there is no door to open... . Shall we go back the way we came?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. That's not it, %s. Since we know that this is Lysithea's space, there is no reason for us to be trapped here.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Someone who loves life wouldn't want it to suffer. Whoop!
(Sylphid lets out the breath it was holding and inflates like a balloon, becoming huge. Then it sticks out its head slightly.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Come up on my shoulder. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, yes!!
(Sylphid checks the condition of %s on his shoulder and turns around. Then, he raises his head and runs somewhere at high speed.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Going out means going out, but I have something to do right now!

steps.name: square notebook
steps.objective:
1. Go from the [Little Blue Bird] in ‘Bayuna Canyon’ to ‘Sylphid’s Rest’. 
2. After checking the contents of the notebook found by [Sylphid], report the quest to [Dana] in “The Other Side of Esnir.”

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, can you hear me?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I heard a new sound from inside.
(Notus and Zephyrus place their faces against the ominous closed door and focus on the sounds coming from inside.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Sting? Sting? It's definitely the sound of a sylphid.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: It's getting closer.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … Something big is rolling by?
(Without deciding who goes first, the brothers look at each other and quickly run back the way they came.)
(After a while, a loud sound is heard from where the door was, as if a blocked water vein had burst.)
Boom!
Boom!
Roll, roll… .
(The thing that exploded inside the door fell to the ground and rolled straight into the path Zephyrus and Notos had run away from.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Zephyrus, don't look back!! Something big is coming!!

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It's already too late... … .
(A shadow large enough to fill the canyon sky floats above the heads of Notos and Zephyrus and instantly engulfs them.)
Boom!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, Sylphid. I talked about slowing down a bit, but in the end... .
(Zephyros and Notos are snuggled up together under the enlarged Sylphid.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Ugh. I’m motion sick… . Purr purr.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Are you okay, Sylphid?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … Is now the time to worry about the Spirit King? From us being crushed under this heavy ball of fur... . uh?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: What are you saying to someone as light as a feather?
(Notos is looking at Zephyrus, who is lying on Sylphid's butt, wondering when he came out.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Oh, I see? It's not like I can't breathe.
(Zephyros holds Notos' hand and crawls out from under Sylphid's butt.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you two okay?

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: As you can see, there's nothing wrong. But why did the door suddenly close?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here's how it happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Notus and Zephyrus the story inside Lysithea's gate. Excluding the matter about Lysithea, as Sylphid requested.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Something like that happened. I'm glad you're safe. I didn't know there were so many people and spirits trapped inside... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: But why don't you come out here?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting! Everyone opened the door and sent them back to their original positions.
(Sylphid must have come to her senses, becoming small and sitting on %s's shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Hmm? The place inside the door is the Demon World. But how did it get to its original location? Is that place connected to several places?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Even if you ask me that much, I still don’t know. Even though he is a spirit king, he cannot know the deepest parts of the world.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Sylphid, thanks to you, many lives have been saved.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. no. This is all thanks to %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I just opened the door with the key... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Oh, it disappeared when the administrator's key came out. In any case, things from the demon world shouldn't come out. No way.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: By the way, Sylphid. The door is still there... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Don't worry. Even if the door remains, this is my territory. I, Spirit King Silphid, used some strength.
(Sylphid shrugs her shoulders and looks smug. Then, she loses her balance and almost falls to the floor, but Notos catches her.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Silphid, be careful.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. thanks. Notos.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. The door is now so that no one but me and %s can enter. Even the demon inside won't be able to come out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what about Baral?
(Sylphid’s expression, which had been explaining in detail to %s’s question, hardens for a moment.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I didn't think of that bad guy. The blowing wind said that he had gone out of the canyon.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Huh. If you leave, you're gone, but something's strange. Where did they go? Disappearing without a trace... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It's okay though. I met Iris, and if I rest a little, I will be able to crush that bad guy if I meet him again later.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Well done, Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Silpin says that all the demons in the canyon have fled. So, today's work is over.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Today's work is over, but demons may appear again someday... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Nemo children. I have something to give you. Follow me to my shelter.
(The silphid that arrived at the shelter flaps its wings vigorously and flies around. Then, it jumps into somewhere and jumps up into the sky.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Notebook?
(Sylphid puts down the notebook she was holding in front of the three people. Then, she spreads her small wings and shakes off the dust.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Maybe Nemo entrusted this to me to meet you guys.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. One day, Nemo had someone send a book to your house when no one was there. The recipient was dear Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I guess you noticed that I often visited your house.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting… . Nemo children. The reason I kept this until now was because I thought there must be a reason.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. But the Magic Agency? It was sealed in that way so I couldn't see it. I think you guys can open it and take a look... . ruler.
(Zephyros receives the notebook given by Sylphid and checks the sealing method.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Thank goodness. It's a simple seal.
(When Zephyrus stretches out his hand, the seal on the notebook seems to have been released, and light rises and then disappears.)
(The faces of the two brothers who were looking at their father's notebook gradually become stiff.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: What on earth did you see, father? Zephyrus. I didn't see anything wrong, right? Wait, did you know that?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: A little… . But, these details... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's wrong? Two of you?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Shout, you square children. What's in there that makes you so freaked out? %s, read what's in that notebook.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Sylphide. Hey guys, can I read this for a moment?
(Adventurer receives the notebook from Notos and Zephyros, who were standing with devastated expressions.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What on earth does it say that makes these two people do that?)

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “Magic… … .」

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “It is just one of the ways to enrich life by borrowing the energy flowing in the world.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “The empire developed through that method, magic, and will continue to develop based on that magic.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “I believe so. Just as the magic tools created by Erenis helped people, my research on wind, one of the elements... .」

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “This is so that many people can have a better daily life..”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “I became a wizard and studied magic in the hope that everyone would be happy. And I went into the Ministry of Magic, hoping that the children would be happy.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “Wizards of the Ministry of Magic. Some were ordinary, some were bold. And some are crazy.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “I happened to see the world of crazy wizards. And they wanted me to join their world.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “I am not a wizard who follows the will of Archmage Zerenis and works for the empire and its people… “I wanted to become a wizard who dreams dirty dreams.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “A world where those with a sense of privilege stand above other humans and all life. “They gathered their strength in the hope of such a world.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “The power gathered to overcome humans like that... .」

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: 「… … … … “He was human.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “It seemed like they were trying to create their own gods for a world where the gods had disappeared.”

lines.speaker: 네모
lines.text: “On Glaston… … .」
(Sylphid snatches the notebook from %s's hand and throws it to Notos.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: On Glaston... I think the part where it is written is the end.
(Zephyros and Notos grab Adventurer, who is shocked by the shocking content, and comfort him.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. %s, calm down.
(Sylphid flies up and lands on %s's head. Then, %s's trembling expression becomes much lighter.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Sylphid. are you okay. Thanks to you, I have stabilized.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It is a gift given to me by Lysithea. When someone who knows me is next to me, my anxieties disappear. Actually, I don't know.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: … The Spirit King had such a good use.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: After touching Silphid, I felt a lot more at ease.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I wish I knew. ah?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then, I will also borrow Silphid for a moment. Ah, I feel calm as expected.
(For some time now, the hands of Zephyrus and Notus have also been caressing Sylphid's wings.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that we know what the enemies inside are up to, we need to be prepared.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Enemies within and without... . The outside is definitely a demon world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. And to be precise, the internal enemy continues to call for the external enemy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Usually, attempts are made to connect with this place from the demon world, but recently, there has been such an attempt on this planet we live on.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. First, I will find the gate to the demon world and inform the goddess. Then you too will know.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I can fly farther only when the Holy Spirit is there. %s, if you hadn't come to the canyon, I wouldn't have been able to say hello or meet Iris.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel reassured.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: With this notebook, I became a little more confident. My father didn't die in an accident... .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Okay, now that I know... .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos, I guess I'll have to go back to the Ministry now and find out more about what they're doing.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: No way. We've only just met. Neither I nor Chloris will allow it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: But, someone has to do it.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes, someone has to do it. Leave it to me this time. I’m also from the Magic Agency, so somehow… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…How can I stop these two people….)
(At that moment, Sylphid looks up at the sky, floats up, and pecks the heads of Notos and Zephyrus alternately.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Evil, Sylphide. stop.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Silphid, it hurts!

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Nemo children. Nemo and Erenis will be sad if they find out that you guys are fighting.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Ugh, we're not fighting... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. You can also go into the enemy's den yourself, but I don't recommend it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: So is there any way?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting… .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Huh? The spirit stone... .
(As Sylphid flaps its wings, the spirit stone in Notos's arms begins to glow.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Throw the spirit stone into the air.
(Notos takes out the spirit stone and throws it into the air, and Sylphid raises her small wings and swings them. Then the spirit stone splits and falls in front of Notos and Zephyrus.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Since you cut it into two pieces, you can keep them together.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Sir Sylphid, why are you taking the spirit stone…? .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Always carry this with you. It may not be everything, but it can enter most places that are hidden and not visible.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. That's why the wind's ability is so good.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Since I have blessed you, I have to take care of you until the end so that Nemo and Erenis are safe.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Thank you, Sylphid… .

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: … Thank you, Sylphid.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. What do you do with something like this? So, do risky things in moderation. Okay?
(Sylphid turns her head as if she is embarrassed.)

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Yes, Sylphide. How should I repay this favor? .

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Should I try catching an earthworm... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Are you really seeing me as a new person? That's okay. If you have any nuts that aren't in the canyon, bring them with you. The almonds Erenice gave me were delicious.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Hahahaha, I understand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It looks good….)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Sylphid?

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I have something to talk about with the two of you. Nemo children. I'm sorry I can't tell you this story.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: No, Sylphide.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: Then we will go home.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. If you're coming to see me later, come to where I rest. I'll welcome you anytime.

lines.speaker: 노토스
lines.text: %s, Silphid. See you later. Thank you for today.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, Sylphide. Thanks to you, I think today will be a day I will remember forever.
(Notus and Zephyrus express their gratitude to Sylphid and %s, and then move on to their house where their childhood memories remain.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Silphid, what do you have to say?
(Sylphid flies over %s's head, lands on it, and turns around. Then something falls in front of it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. When I was stuck inside the door, I found it and packed it away. Because your name was written there.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It feels like Lux's power, but I've roughly purified it, so there's no problem if you touch it. But what is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a sealed edict from the emperor of the empire. Why was this there... .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Are you talking about the young emperor with the power of prophecy? You must have grown a lot in 10 years. Please read it. What is written... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: 「Dear %s… .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “It was originally a letter that was supposed to be delivered formally, but we have prepared a little trap for anyone who gets in our way.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “It may reach %s properly, but it may also be found in an unexpected place. If this is found in the realm of the demon world... .」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “It was brought by that saboteur. The name of the disruptor is Aaron, Aaron Tiernes.”

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “He is the one who acts as Lux’s shadow. And if you see this letter, please let Dana know.”

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Lux's shadow? So the demons were living by imitating humans?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know much about that. First of all, I knew that I was not an ordinary human... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to talk to Dana.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. Where is this guy named Dana? I'll send it to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you please send it to Esnil? Ah, Esnil… .

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. It's a town with that name. It's called the Guild Union, right? Silpin said he was happy because there was an elf named Zelik who fed him well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's right. A place where there are wonderful elves who provide food without regard for people or birds.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I'll send you there. If the Spirit King of Wind used all his power, it wouldn't be a problem to blow you away from the West to the East.

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Sting. I was really, really thankful this time. And I will become stronger and help you properly later.  It was nice to meet you. See you later. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was happy too. See you later, Silphid.
(Sylphid sits on the ground and flaps its small wings. Then, small leaves come from somewhere with a warm wind and embrace %s's body.)

lines.speaker: 실피드
lines.text: Goodbye, %s.
(The warm wind that approaches carries Adventurer and blows it away somewhere.)

steps.name: vortex of fate
steps.objective: Talk to [Dana] in “The Other Side of Esnil” and greet guests who come to [Dana]. Then report the quest to [Dana] in [Guild Alliance City Esnil].

lines.text: (The leaves hovering around %s disappear. A dark shadow falls between them, and the unfamiliar figure of Esnil approaches.)
(And in front of it, Dana can be seen holding %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Dana… ?
(Dana pulls the hand of %s that was holding so that it can come down to the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I was floating.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Can you feel the warm wind from %s? But how did you get here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Esnil here… . ah… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: This is the other side of Esnil. A place where only people who know can come and go. It can only come through me.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: By the way, when did I bring you here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sure. I think it came at some point.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You came to visit me, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, that's right. This is a bit of a long story, do you have time?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's okay. I was supposed to meet someone here. %s is also someone I know.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I see. yes? Is it really your Majesty?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My sister again... . Ha, I can't help it. First, let me listen to your story.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay, then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Dana everything that happened in Bayuna Canyon.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … Something like that happened. A man named Baral helped Vice with his work in Eastland and visited the Demon World, so I was keeping an eye on him.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I told Ricotta to follow Baral, but he suddenly disappeared. After listening to %s's story, I think I understand now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It makes sense if you went to the demon world back then. And Aaron… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We all decided that Aaron was a follower working for the demons, but we found out after reading my sister's letter. That's completely wrong.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Since Aaron is a real demon, all of this fits... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Prosperous wizards just want to surpass their prowess, and Aaron just takes advantage of them.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Who wants a new god? ha… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Mr. %s, everyone is going to be busier now than before.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will help you as much as I can, Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We'll do our job, so %s do your own job, %s. That's right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ah, Mr. %s. My sister is coming soon, so I'll go out for a bit. Please wait a moment.
(At that time, someone walks slowly between the dark shadows that covered Esnil's back.)
(As the shadow gradually disappears, a woman who is nobler than anyone in the empire waves at the two people.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty… ?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister? How did my sister get here…? . I told you I would come pick you up.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry. I can't just wait... .  How are you, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sister, no one can discover this side, and no one can enter... … .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Wait… . What is it, sister?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I won't hide it anymore.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, what are you trying to say... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Talk later… … .
(Dayna must have read something in Kaina's expression and turns her back. Then, she quickly runs in the opposite direction Kaina came from.)
(I follow, but it seems that Dayna has already left Esnil's side. Only Kaina and %s remain behind her.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, I'll talk to Dana later. Could you please listen to my story?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It's unknown since when, but members of the Sylvaria royal family have shown special talents that ordinary people do not have.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Although it appeared very rarely, it was an advantage the royal family could boast over ordinary citizens.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: My great-aunt had a talent for finding special relics, and the youngest child, Shiina, was more talented in magic than any other member of the royal family.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dana and I didn't have any special talents, but it was okay. Because I was doing well every day.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: However, something happened 10 years ago that changed everything. At some point, I realized the power of precognition, and Dana began to walk behind the scenes.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It started out as little things, but as time went by, I started seeing more things.
(At that moment, Kaina's eyes sparkle. After a while, a large illusion with a shape is created in front of the two.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh? Mirror? Clock? What is that?)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You can see this.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: My abilities are not the royal family's special talents... .
(The hour and minute hands on the mirror's illusion suddenly start rotating at high speed, and unknown scenes quickly pass by in the mirror.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The power spread by the Goddess of the Black Moon fell on Freios and was reflected in various forms... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No way… .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: At some point, I woke up... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I thought this power, this ability, was entirely mine, but I guess that wasn't the case. %s, I'm scared... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: … I want to run away, but I can't... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty… … .
(Kaina approaches %s and grabs his hands.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: %s, can you trust me?
(At that moment, the hour and minute hands on the mirror illusion stop. After that, the scenes passing quickly stop and a certain scene is shown to the two people.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty, this is… … .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: What I see inside is my future that I continue to see... .

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: For everyone's sake, we have to get out of this future. If that doesn't work, I... .
(As if to reflect Kaina's mind, which seemed to be in confusion, the hour and minute hands in the mirror illusion rotated again at high speed. Then, at some point, they exploded with a loud roar.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: … … Ugh… . Ugh… … … .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty? Your Majesty!! Are you okay?
(The moment you try to approach Kaina, who is in pain, Dana appears and blocks you.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, step aside. I'll take care of this here.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Mr. %s, I will take care of you. My sister just lost her mind. It'll be okay... . My sister… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Dana… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Get out first. I'm waiting outside... .
(Dana slowly walks out of the Guild Federation Headquarters building. She limps slightly, probably because she's overworked herself more than usual.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Dana… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My sister is okay. I took the medicine and fell asleep... . I contacted Argent, so he will be taken to the imperial castle as soon as he wakes up.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … So what kind of future do you see together?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Tell me… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: This is the future you were trying to change, right? Please, tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Okay… . What I and Your Majesty saw was... .
(Dana listens to %s and nods quietly.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Neither I nor my sister are the little girls who ran away 10 years ago. Now that you're an adult, you can't run away.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And I have to do my best as my shoulders become heavier. Aside from that, I also have to fulfill my royal duties.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: My sister always tries to carry everything on her own... . ha… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everything will be okay.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: %s, see you then. Take some rest today... . It's hard coming from far away... . See you soon in Glaston.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . Rest easy, Dana.
(Dana smiles lightly and slowly enters the guild union headquarters.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm feeling tired now. I need to get some rest too... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I still remember what I saw a little while ago...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I’m afraid….)
(Kaina and %s, what they saw in the mirror illusion was….)
(With the huge city becoming a sea of fire, two people were dying painfully by someone. And a being who had become a god was approaching...)
